hero.description: Professionally planned enduro tours around Vilnius — an unforgettable experience for both beginners and experienced riders.

motorcycle.heading: Modern Honda CRF300L
motorcycle.text: Ride brand-new Honda CRF300L motorcycles, designed for off-road adventures.

route.heading: Routes Around Vilnius
route.text: Discover carefully planned forest trails, gravel roads, and the most beautiful areas around Vilnius.

everyone.heading: Suitable for Everyone
everyone.text: Tours are designed for both beginners and experienced riders.

short.title: 2.5h Tour
short.intro: A perfect choice for those trying an enduro motorcycle for the first time or looking for a quick escape from the city.

features.feature2: Scenic forest roads and gravel tracks
features.feature4: Route adapted to your experience level

medium.title: 4h Tour
medium.intro: A longer route for those who want to experience more varied terrain and improve their riding skills.

features.feature2: Fast gravel roads and more technical forest trails
features.feature3: A wider variety of off-road sections
features.feature4: Great choice for riders with some experience

fullDay.title: Full-Day Tour
fullDay.intro: A full-day adventure for those who want to make the most of their time on the bike.

features.feature1: ~300 km route around the Vilnius region
features.feature2: A wide variety of terrain — from gravel roads to off-road sections
features.feature4: Stops to rest and enjoy the surroundings

rental.title: Motorcycle rental
rental.topText: For those who prefer to ride independently, we offer Honda CRF300L motorcycle rentals. We currently have three motorcycles available.
rental.bottomText: Create your own adventure and discover the hidden trails and scenic routes surrounding Vilnius.

beforeTrip.title: Before trip

equipment.intro: Before each ride, every participant is provided with all the necessary protective gear:
equipment.bootsDisclaimer: Protective boots are currently available in EU sizes 44–45. If you require a different size, we recommend bringing your own motorcycle boots.

beforeTrip.closingText: All you need is a good attitude and the desire to experience a true enduro adventure.

gallery.photoDescription: A moment captured during our enduro tour
